voiceGuide: Guide Grade 1 children to drag the correct animal name onto a photo. Read the welcome, each question prompt, correct answers with the animal name, wrong-answer feedback, and end-game celebration aloud in a warm, encouraging tone.

welcome.text: Welcome to Animal Photo Match! Look at the animal photo and drag the correct name on top of it. Let's go!

question.text: Which animal is in the picture? Drag the right name here!

wrong.text: Oops, that's not it. Try another name!

great_job.text: Great job! You know so many animals!

try_again.text: Good try! Keep practicing and you'll match them all!

all_done.text: Amazing! You matched every animal perfectly! You are an animal expert!

correct_alligator.text: Yes! That's an Alligator! Alligators have powerful jaws and live near water.

correct_arcticfox.text: Yes! That's an Arctic Fox! Its thick white fur keeps it warm in the snowy Arctic.

correct_camel.text: Yes! That's a Camel! Camels store fat in their humps to travel across hot deserts.

correct_cheetah.text: Yes! That's a Cheetah! Cheetahs are the fastest land animals on Earth.

correct_clownfish.text: Yes! That's a Clownfish! Clownfish live safely inside sea anemones.

correct_crocodile.text: Yes! That's a Crocodile! Crocodiles are big reptiles with strong tails for swimming.

correct_eagle.text: Yes! That's an Eagle! Eagles have sharp eyes and soar high in the sky.

correct_elephant.text: Yes! That's an Elephant! Elephants use their long trunks to spray water and pick up food.

correct_fennecfox.text: Yes! That's a Fennec Fox! Its huge ears help it stay cool in the desert.

correct_giraffee.text: Yes! That's a Giraffe! Giraffes have very long necks to reach leaves on tall trees.

correct_koala.text: Yes! That's a Koala! Koalas sleep a lot and love eating eucalyptus leaves.

correct_leopard.text: Yes! That's a Leopard! Leopards have beautiful spots and are excellent climbers.

correct_lion.text: Yes! That's a Lion! Lions are called the kings of the jungle and live in groups called prides.

correct_octopus.text: Yes! That's an Octopus! Octopuses have eight arms and can change color to hide.

correct_panda.text: Yes! That's a Panda! Giant pandas love munching on bamboo all day long.

correct_parrot.text: Yes! That's a Parrot! Parrots are colorful birds that can mimic sounds and words.

correct_polarbear.text: Yes! That's a Polar Bear! Polar bears have thick fur and fat to stay warm on the ice.

correct_racoon.text: Yes! That's a Raccoon! Raccoons have little black masks and wash their food before eating.

correct_redfox.text: Yes! That's a Red Fox! Red foxes are clever animals with big fluffy tails.

correct_snake.text: Yes! That's a Snake! Snakes slither on their bellies and smell with their tongues.

correct_tiger.text: Yes! That's a Tiger! Tigers have orange fur with black stripes and are strong swimmers.

correct_toucan.text: Yes! That's a Toucan! Toucans have huge colorful beaks and live in rainforests.
